text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock A and Stock E at large losses, then bought them again; I should use clear reasons and rules for trades rather than reacting inconsistently to price moves.","Buying more stocks during a decline is not automatically a bargain; I should assess each holding’s risks and keep my portfolio diversified.","My account value has fallen substantially overall, so I should review my allocation and progress toward my apartment goal regularly, while investing steadily rather than chasing quick gains."]}
